greeting.text: Carry the frontier witness into a shared civic record. Our capital is Trawamprahshoaw. Its principal will register this work after the local balance. The outlying witness is at Trawamprah (460, 1340).

choices.text: Carry the frontier witness into a shared civic record.

actions.value: Keep the wisdom obligation; publish revisions honestly.

hint:mission:human:wisdom.text: Carry the frontier witness into a shared civic record. Inspect Trawamprah at 460, 1340, listen to the visiting witness, and repair the circuit beside Humans Mediator. Inspect the independent reading at Trawamprah. Listen to the Greek Horde witness. Record a testable commitment with the circuit keeper. Restore the regional circuit.
